scope: Broad installed-client mechanics inventory, not all-game behavior certification
selection: GA_, GE_, GMMC_, GCN_ asset prefixes across archive; containing directories also include dependencies. Nonmatching assets outside these directories remain unexamined.
limits: Bytecode roundtrip verifies decoding only; not native functions, default bindings or server parity.
Raw exports require property schemas; no usmap/pdb entries found in archive index.
Existing baseline reader used basename output; this pass preserves full paths to avoid collisions.
Extracted/decoded is not manually reviewed or integrated into the simulator.
Archive assets may include unused, retired or unreleased content; directory presence does not establish active roster/mechanics.
